projects.title: Conversational AI Warehouse Management System
projects.summary: End-to-end intelligent inventory system utilizing conversational LLM agents, automated webhook workflows, and isolated multi-container architecture.
highlights: Engineered Flask REST API and n8n workflows integrated with an LLM Agent for real-time stock inquiries and automated logging.
Orchestrated a decoupled multi-container infrastructure using Docker Compose (backend API, web chat UI, and n8n engine).
Implemented Pandas data pipelines to calculate inventory health and generate automated understock trend visual charts.
Fortified application security with output HTML sanitization (XSS defense) and prompt injection safeguards.

projects.title: Data Analytics & Visualization for Retail Sales
projects.summary: Comprehensive exploratory data analysis and executive dashboard development evaluating multi-channel transactional retail data.
highlights: Processed a 990-transaction dataset evaluating revenue, profit margins, discounts, customer tiers, and regional distribution.
Conducted data wrangling in Python (Pandas): group-based median imputation, date formatting, and margin metric derivations.
Engineered interactive Power BI dashboards with correlation heatmaps, sales trends, and channel performance metrics.
Formulated actionable business insights identifying top revenue drivers and uncovering discount elasticity patterns.

projects.title: Object-Oriented Polyclinic Appointment System
projects.summary: Full SDLC system analysis, UML architectural modeling, and functional web prototype for patient appointment scheduling.
highlights: Analyzed polyclinic workflows to eliminate scheduling bottlenecks, defining functional and non-functional requirements.
Modeled comprehensive system architecture via UML (Use Case, Activity, Sequence, and Class Diagrams).
Built a responsive web portal prototype with separate interfaces for Patients, Doctors, and Administrators using JavaScript.
Implemented automated conflict-detection algorithms to prevent doctor overbooking and reduce patient wait times.

projects.title: Computer Retail Enterprise System Analysis
projects.summary: Formal Software Requirement Specification (SKPL) documentation and role-based interface wireframing.
highlights: Collaborated in a 6-member team to author comprehensive SKPL/SRS documents detailing sales, order processing, and inventory.
Constructed full UML behavioral diagrams capturing business workflows for 4 distinct actor profiles.
Designed modular user interface wireframes for Customers, Sales, Delivery, and Executive Management.

projects.title: UI/UX Design Proposal for Digital Reading Platform
projects.summary: Iterative UI/UX design proposal and interactive prototyping for a digital comic and novel platform.
highlights: Collaborated in a 6-member student team utilizing Agile methodology and Figma for iterative design.
Conducted competitive analysis and SWOT evaluation benchmarking platforms like Webtoon and Wattpad to drive intuitive navigation.
Created low-fidelity and high-fidelity wireframes for login, landing, bookmarks, and community forums focusing on minimalist UX.
Designed user flows, color systems, and clickable prototypes addressing copyright compliance and community engagement.
Administered Windows OS environments, AV equipment, and IT hardware to ensure high stability during campus events.
Diagnosed and resolved networking, laptop, and projection malfunctions under fast-paced event conditions.
Maintained structured organizational inventory databases, streamlining resource tracking and asset allocation.
